original_request: <<e.g. 'תכתוב הודעת תפוצה לקבוצה על פתיחת המחזור החדש'>>
brief: <<what the recipient should do after reading>>
brand_voice: <<how you actually write in WhatsApp, usually shorter and warmer than the website>>
constraints: one question at most, and it must be answerable with a short reply
desired_output: a single WhatsApp message, ready to send
success_criteria: <<e.g. 'a reply of yes is unambiguous, because there is only one open question'>>
notes: A message that invites a reply with nowhere to land is worse than one that asks nothing.
